# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.py from the live tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every action Jarvis can perform is a **tool** with a typed schema. The interpreters (the built-in English/Spanish rules,
or an optional AI model) can only produce calls to these tools; every call is validated against the schema before
anything runs. You can call a tool directly with `jarvisctl --tool NAME --args '{...}'` (see [IPC.md](IPC.md)).

Common conventions:

* Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd`; date-times are ISO 8601 with an offset (`2026-10-18T18:00:00+01:00`); times are 24-hour `HH:mm`.
* Every tool answers with a status, a human-readable message in your language, structured `data` with real identifiers,
  and a verification result (`verified`, `unverified` with the reason, or `not applicable`).
* Tools that delete data never run without an explicit, single-use confirmation.

## Apple Music

_Backend: AppleScript to the Music app (Automation permission)._

### `music.list_playlists`

Lists the user's playlists.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum playlists to return. (default: `100`) |

### `music.next`

Skips to the next track.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

_No parameters._

### `music.now_playing`

Reads the current track and playback information.

* **Effect:** read-only

_No parameters._

### `music.pause`

Pauses playback.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

_No parameters._

### `music.play`

Plays music from the user's Apple Music library that matches the query.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Song, album or artist to play. Quote the title only, e.g. "Bohemian Rhapsody". |
| `artist` | `string` | no | Artist to disambiguate a song or album. |
| `kind` | `enum(any\|song\|album\|artist)` | no | What the query names. (default: `"any"`) |
| `shuffle` | `boolean` | no | Shuffle albums/artists. |
| `track_id` | `string` | no | Exact persistent id of a track returned by music.search (skips ranking). |

### `music.play_playlist`

Plays one of the user's playlists by name.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Playlist name. |
| `playlist_id` | `string` | no | Exact persistent id of the playlist (skips name matching). |
| `shuffle` | `boolean` | no | Play in shuffled order. |

### `music.previous`

Returns to the previous track.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

_No parameters._

### `music.resume`

Resumes (or starts) playback.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

_No parameters._

### `music.search`

Searches the user's Music library.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Text to search for. |
| `kind` | `enum(any\|song\|album\|artist)` | no | Restrict the search. (default: `"any"`) |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum results. (default: `10`) |

### `music.set_volume`

Sets Music's volume (0–100) or changes it by a relative amount.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** exactly one of: level, delta

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delta` | `integer` | no | Relative change, -100…100. |
| `level` | `integer` | no | Absolute volume, 0–100. |

### `music.stop`

Stops playback.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

_No parameters._

## Reminders

_Backend: EventKit (Reminders full access)._

### `reminders.complete`

Marks a reminder completed (or not completed).

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | `boolean` | no | false reopens the reminder. (default: `true`) |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact reminder id (from reminders.list). |
| `list` | `string` | no | Restrict to this reminders list. |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the reminder. |

### `reminders.create`

Creates a reminder, optionally in a named list and with a due date/time.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | What to be reminded of. |
| `create_list_if_missing` | `boolean` | no | Create the list when it does not exist. |
| `due` | `date\|datetime` | no | Due date (yyyy-MM-dd) or date-time with offset. |
| `list` | `string` | no | Reminders list name; default list when omitted. |
| `list_id` | `string` | no | Exact list id (skips name matching). |
| `notes` | `string` | no | Notes for the reminder. |
| `priority` | `enum(none\|low\|medium\|high)` | no | Priority. (default: `"none"`) |

### `reminders.create_list`

Creates a new reminders list.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name of the new list. |

### `reminders.delete`

Deletes a reminder after confirmation.

* **Effect:** deletes data — always asks first
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact reminder id (from reminders.list). |
| `list` | `string` | no | Restrict to this reminders list. |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the reminder. |

### `reminders.list`

Lists reminders filtered by list, status and due date.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `due_from` | `date\|datetime` | no | Only reminders due on/after this moment. |
| `due_to` | `date\|datetime` | no | Only reminders due before this moment. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum reminders. (default: `50`) |
| `list` | `string` | no | Only this list. |
| `query` | `string` | no | Only reminders whose title contains this text. |
| `status` | `enum(pending\|completed\|all)` | no | Which reminders. (default: `"pending"`) |

### `reminders.list_lists`

Lists the user's reminder lists.

* **Effect:** read-only

_No parameters._

### `reminders.update`

Changes a reminder's title, due date, notes, list or priority.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title
* **Constraint:** at least one of: new_title, new_due, clear_due, new_notes, new_list, new_priority

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clear_due` | `boolean` | no | Remove the due date. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact reminder id (from reminders.list). |
| `list` | `string` | no | Restrict to this reminders list. |
| `new_due` | `date\|datetime` | no | New due date or date-time. |
| `new_list` | `string` | no | Move to this list. |
| `new_notes` | `string` | no | New notes. |
| `new_priority` | `enum(none\|low\|medium\|high)` | no | New priority. |
| `new_title` | `string` | no | New title. |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the reminder. |

## Notes

_Backend: AppleScript to the Notes app (Automation permission)._

### `notes.append`

Adds text at the end of an existing note, preserving what is there.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | yes | Text to add. |
| `account` | `string` | no | Restrict to this account name (iCloud, Gmail…). |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Restrict to this folder name. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact note id (from notes.search / notes.list). |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the note. |

### `notes.create`

Creates a note, optionally in a specific folder/account. The title becomes the first line.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: title, content

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | `string` | no | Destination account name. |
| `account_id` | `string` | no | Exact account id. |
| `content` | `string` | no | Body text; line breaks become paragraphs. |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Destination folder name. |
| `folder_id` | `string` | no | Exact folder id (skips name matching). |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title of the note. |

### `notes.delete`

Moves a note to Recently Deleted after confirmation.

* **Effect:** deletes data — always asks first
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | `string` | no | Restrict to this account name (iCloud, Gmail…). |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Restrict to this folder name. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact note id (from notes.search / notes.list). |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the note. |

### `notes.list`

Lists the most recently modified notes.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | `string` | no | Only this account. |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Only this folder. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum notes. (default: `25`) |

### `notes.list_folders`

Lists the folders of every Notes account.

* **Effect:** read-only

_No parameters._

### `notes.read`

Returns the text of one note.

* **Effect:** read-only
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | `string` | no | Restrict to this account name (iCloud, Gmail…). |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Restrict to this folder name. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact note id (from notes.search / notes.list). |
| `max_chars` | `integer` | no | Maximum characters to return. (default: `6000`) |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the note. |

### `notes.search`

Searches note titles and (optionally) their text.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Text to look for. |
| `account` | `string` | no | Only this account. |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Only this folder. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum results. (default: `20`) |
| `scope` | `enum(title\|any)` | no | title = titles only (fast); any = titles and body text. (default: `"any"`) |

### `notes.update`

Replaces a note's text and/or renames it. The title line is kept unless a new title is given.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title
* **Constraint:** at least one of: new_content, new_title

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | `string` | no | Restrict to this account name (iCloud, Gmail…). |
| `folder` | `string` | no | Restrict to this folder name. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact note id (from notes.search / notes.list). |
| `new_content` | `string` | no | Replacement body text. |
| `new_title` | `string` | no | New title. |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the note. |

## Calendar

_Backend: EventKit (Calendars full access)._

### `calendar.check_conflicts`

Lists events overlapping a time range, i.e. whether the user is free.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `end` | `datetime` | yes | End of the range. |
| `start` | `datetime` | yes | Start of the range. |
| `calendar` | `string` | no | Only this calendar. |

### `calendar.create_event`

Creates an event. A date without a time creates an all-day event.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at most one of: end, duration_minutes

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `date\|datetime` | yes | Start (date-time) or day (all-day). |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Event title. |
| `alert_minutes` | `integer` | no | Alert this many minutes before. |
| `all_day` | `boolean` | no | Make it an all-day event. |
| `allow_conflicts` | `boolean` | no | Create even if it overlaps another event. |
| `attendees` | `string[]` | no | Names of people involved (looked up in Contacts when enabled; invitations are not sent). |
| `calendar` | `string` | no | Destination calendar name. |
| `calendar_id` | `string` | no | Exact calendar id. |
| `duration_minutes` | `integer` | no | Duration; the default from Settings when neither end nor duration is given. |
| `end` | `datetime` | no | End date-time. |
| `location` | `string` | no | Location. |
| `notes` | `string` | no | Notes. |

### `calendar.delete_event`

Deletes an event after confirmation.

* **Effect:** deletes data — always asks first
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title, on_date

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at_time` | `time` | no | Start time of the event (HH:mm) to tell events on the same day apart. |
| `calendar` | `string` | no | Only events in this calendar. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact event id (from calendar.list_events). |
| `on_date` | `date` | no | Day the event is on (yyyy-MM-dd). Without it, upcoming events are searched. |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the event. |

### `calendar.list_calendars`

Lists the user's calendars.

* **Effect:** read-only

_No parameters._

### `calendar.list_events`

Lists events between two moments.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `end` | `date\|datetime` | yes | End of the range (exclusive). |
| `start` | `date\|datetime` | yes | Start of the range. |
| `calendar` | `string` | no | Only this calendar. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum events. (default: `100`) |
| `query` | `string` | no | Only events whose title contains this text. |

### `calendar.update_event`

Changes an event's title, time, duration, location, notes or calendar.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: id, title, on_date
* **Constraint:** at least one of: new_title, new_location, new_notes, new_date, new_time, new_start, new_end, new_duration_minutes, new_calendar
* **Constraint:** at most one of: new_start, new_date
* **Constraint:** at most one of: new_start, new_time
* **Constraint:** at most one of: new_end, new_duration_minutes

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_conflicts` | `boolean` | no | Apply even if the new slot overlaps another event. |
| `at_time` | `time` | no | Start time of the event (HH:mm) to tell events on the same day apart. |
| `calendar` | `string` | no | Only events in this calendar. |
| `id` | `string` | no | Exact event id (from calendar.list_events). |
| `new_calendar` | `string` | no | Move to this calendar. |
| `new_date` | `date` | no | Move to this day, keeping the time. |
| `new_duration_minutes` | `integer` | no | New duration. |
| `new_end` | `datetime` | no | New exact end. |
| `new_location` | `string` | no | New location. |
| `new_notes` | `string` | no | New notes. |
| `new_start` | `datetime` | no | New exact start (the duration is kept). |
| `new_time` | `time` | no | Move to this time of day, keeping the day. |
| `new_title` | `string` | no | New title. |
| `on_date` | `date` | no | Day the event is on (yyyy-MM-dd). Without it, upcoming events are searched. |
| `title` | `string` | no | Title (or part of it) of the event. |

## Clock (alarms and timers)

_Backend: Apple Shortcuts actions of the Clock app, through shortcuts you create once (see SHORTCUTS_SETUP.md)._

### `alarms.create`

Creates a Clock alarm that rings at the next occurrence of the given time.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | `time` | yes | Time of day (HH:mm, 24 h). |
| `date` | `date` | no | The day the user expects it to ring. Clock alarms ring at the next occurrence of the time; if that is another day, Jarvis refuses instead of creating a misleading alarm. |
| `label` | `string` | no | Alarm label. |
| `repeat_days` | `string[]` | no | Weekdays to repeat (mon…sun). Not supported by Jarvis' shortcut contract. |

### `alarms.delete`

Deletes an alarm after confirmation.

* **Effect:** deletes data — always asks first
* **Constraint:** at least one of: time, label

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | no | Label (or part of it) of the alarm. |
| `time` | `time` | no | Time of the alarm (HH:mm, 24 h). |
| `time_is_ambiguous` | `boolean` | no | true when the user gave no AM/PM: both HH:mm and HH:mm+12h match. |

### `alarms.list`

Lists the alarms in the Clock app.

* **Effect:** read-only

_No parameters._

### `alarms.set_enabled`

Enables or disables an existing alarm.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)
* **Constraint:** at least one of: time, label

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | yes | true = on, false = off. |
| `label` | `string` | no | Label (or part of it) of the alarm. |
| `time` | `time` | no | Time of the alarm (HH:mm, 24 h). |
| `time_is_ambiguous` | `boolean` | no | true when the user gave no AM/PM: both HH:mm and HH:mm+12h match. |

### `timers.cancel`

Cancels the running timer.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

_No parameters._

### `timers.create`

Starts the Clock timer.

* **Effect:** changes something (nothing is deleted)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration_seconds` | `integer` | yes | Duration in seconds. |
| `label` | `string` | no | Timer label (the Clock action cannot store it; it is only echoed back). |

## Contacts

_Backend: Contacts framework (optional; Contacts permission)._

### `contacts.find`

Looks up people in Contacts by name.

* **Effect:** read-only

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Name (or part of it) to look for. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum results. (default: `5`) |
